description: The substation segmentation research team publishes preprocessing and postprocessing scripts used with its fifteen-class Brazilian substation image dataset. Python, Bash and notebook components convert polygonal JSON and YOLO box annotations into segmentation masks, split training sets, and filter classes during iterative learning. The GitHub README documents the individual utilities and an example workflow, and the MIT licence permits free reuse. These globally applicable tools can prepare visual asset inventories for electricity-infrastructure digital twins. They require the associated images and a separate learning implementation, and do not infer electrical connectivity or simulate power flows. Execution was not tested. No directly related catalogue platform was identified.
